testcase.name: Scenario: Add and remove a ribbon command through its context menu: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/current-quick-access-source/features/application/quick-access-toolbar/quick-access-toolbar.feature:71:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Add and remove a ribbon command through its context menu ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And Extrude is available on the 3D Model ribbon ✔ And Extrude is not on the quick access toolbar ✔ When the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon ✔ Then its context menu offers Add to Quick Access Toolbar ✔ When the user chooses Add to Quick Access Toolbar ✔ Then an Extrude icon appears on the quick access toolbar ✔ And Extrude remains available on the ribbon ✔ When the user right-clicks the added quick access icon ✔ Then its context menu offers Remove from Quick Access Toolbar ✔ When the user chooses Remove from Quick Access Toolbar ✔ Then the added icon disappears from the quick access toolbar ✔ And Extrude remains available on the ribbon ✔ And the same part remains active
